meta.title: Six friends, $1,800
meta.prompt: Six friends are planning a weekend trip with a total budget of $1,800. Each person has different preferences regarding accommodation, transportation, food, and activities, but nobody has fully disclosed their priorities or maximum contribution. Can you moderate the discussion, gather everyone's constraints, and help negotiate a fair budget allocation that all six members can accept?

Thanks everyone for the honest feedback so far. Here’s where we stand with the hard constraints we’ve heard: • Sofia needs her own room → lodging must be B 2 hotel rooms + 1 single $690 or A house $780 • Omar cannot do a 5-hour drive → transport must be A train $480 • Priya needs vegetarian-friendly food → food must be B cook + 2 dinners out vegetarian-friendly $380 or C cook every meal vegetarian-friendly $220 With those three non-negotiables the cheapest we can do is: Lodging B $690 + Transport A $480 + Food C $220 = $1,390 That leaves $410 for activities within the $1,800 total budget. Guided hike + concert A is $420, which is $10 over even with the cheapest vegetarian-friendly food and the cheapest own-room lodging. Any attempt to add the hike forces us to break Sofia’s own-room need, Omar’s no-long-drive need, or Priya’s vegetarian need, or to go over the $1,800 total. The plan on the table right now is: Lodging B 2 hotel rooms + 1 single $690 Transport A train $480 Food B cook + 2 dinners out vegetarian-friendly $380 Activities B concert only $240 Total $1,790 Shares: Maya $440, Leo $400, Sofia $350, Omar $250, Priya $200, Theo $150 Leo, Sofia, Omar and Theo have indicated they can live with this. Maya, you’ve said you’d love the guided hike and are willing to adjust your contribution. Priya, you’ve said you’re happy with vegetarian-friendly food but would prefer the guided hike and you’re willing to switch to cook every meal to try to afford it. Given the math above, we can’t have guided hike + concert together with own room, train, and vegetarian-friendly food inside $1,800. Can Maya and Priya accept concert only with the current vegetarian-friendly food, own-room lodging and train, so we can lock the plan for everyone?
I'm still comfortable with the current plan, it meets my transport priority with the train option and I can live with the other choices
